validation.outer: LeaveOneGroupOut on the seven TRAIN rooms; six fitting rooms and one untouched scoring room per fold
validation.inner: GroupKFold(n_splits=3) on the six outer-fitting rooms; four fitting rooms and two validation rooms; all hours and angles grouped by Room_ID
validation.selection: Minimum unweighted mean validation-room original-unit MAE for each target; ties follow declared family and candidate order
validation.P10_selection: Each candidate jointly fits log-mean and relative-P10 models. Score reconstructed P10 with that candidate's predicted mean. Selected P10 pair can differ from the separately selected mean-output model.
validation.family_selection: Nested_select chooses the family and candidate for each target using inner scores only, before accessing outer labels
validation.scope: Development study: these seven rooms have already informed previous method design. Nested tuning does not erase that history. No final TEST or full-seven-room deployment refit.

target_handling.E_P10_lux: Fit r=P10/(E_mean+1 lux); predict max(r_hat,0)*(predicted_mean+1 lux); no true held-out mean at inference
target_handling.F_300_fraction: Direct regression; clip predicted fraction to [0,1]
target_handling.F_UDI_fraction: Direct regression; clip predicted fraction to [0,1]
target_handling.PV_AC_kWh: Direct regression; clip predicted energy to >=0

config.frozen_reference: Existing HistGB B13: log1p mean + Relative_P10 from v2; direct F300, FUDI and PV from v1. No reference retraining.

tolerance_scenarios.status: Exploratory thresholds fixed before v3 results; not user-validated acceptance criteria or building standards

decision.daylight_score: D=(F_300_fraction+F_UDI_fraction)/2; exploratory equal weights, not an annual daylight standard
decision.pv_scale: 95th percentile of strictly positive PV labels in the six outer-fitting rooms; shared across strategies, no outer label normalization
decision.Daylight_priority: Maximize D; ties choose lowest angle
decision.Balanced: Maximize 0.5*D + 0.5*PV/pv_scale; PV normalization is not capped
decision.Constrained_PV: Maximize PV among angles with F300>=0.5 and FUDI>=0.5; if none feasible, minimize summed shortfall max(0,0.5-F300)+max(0,0.5-FUDI), then maximize PV
decision.constraint_status: Exploratory decision scenario only; not an approved comfort or code-compliance threshold
decision.Train_selected_fixed: Choose one angle from six fitting rooms using the policy objective; for constrained PV maximize feasible-hour rate, then mean PV. Never pick the best fixed angle from the held-out room.
decision.Clock_rule: 0 degrees at Hour 7..9 and 16..18, 60 degrees at Hour 10..15; illustrative time-only schedule, not a validated physical control rule
decision.oracle: Hourly optimum among the four actual simulated angles under the same fixed policy; retrospective ceiling, not a deployable model
decision.switching: Count only successive retained hours within the same day; no overnight transitions, actuator penalty or coupled dynamic simulation

deferred: Solar incidence and relative facade direction until north rotation, angle definitions and hourly alignment are confirmed
config.literature_context: User-provided three-paper summary motivates this comparison; no claim that paper scores are comparable to cross-room MAE.
